edit.statement: 'Derives from' is no longer transitive: a chain of etymological derivations does not by itself license the derivation from the first word to the last.
edit.subject: derived_from
edit.original: 'Derives from' is transitive: if word a derives from word b and b derives from word c, then a derives from c.
edit.scope: Etymological derivation between words across languages; asymmetry is unchanged.
